methodologyNote: Ran TWO probes today. First probe (li-cascade-save-2026-05-14.raw.json) unchecked parent without first forcing child=checked — produced misleading 'PARTIAL-FE-FIX' verdicts because pre-state children happened to be unchecked already. Second probe (li-cascade-force-precondition-2026-05-14.raw.json) explicitly set child=true via UI+save+reload BEFORE testing parent-uncheck cascade — this is the correct test of BUG-LI-002/003's claim that child stays checked+enabled when parent unchecks. Findings below are from the second probe.

aggregateFinding: All 3 cascade groups (Service Charge, Apply LDW, Apply C&C) reproduce BUG-LI-002 + BUG-LI-003 end-to-end when child is forced to checked before parent uncheck. The server endpoint POST /navigator/api/location/update-properties returns 200 OK and persists the malformed {parent: false, child: true} state across reload for all 3 groups. This is BOTH a frontend defect (missing cascade + missing disable-propagation on modifier checkboxes) AND a backend defect (no server-side validation rejecting the inconsistent state).

isIsNot.IS: 3 specific groups (Service Charge, Apply LDW, Apply C&C) where the modifier-checkbox children (Show As Admin Fee, calc-*-on-net-amount) do not cascade-disable when their parent unchecks; server also accepts the malformed state.
isIsNot.ISNOT: The 8 other parent-children groups (ETS, Resort Tax, Comm Receiver, Intercompany, Set/Strike Minutes, Company Remit Tax, Allow DPCD, Skip Billing) where cascade fires correctly; also the percentage-INPUT child of LDW/C&C, which DOES disable on parent uncheck — only the modifier-CHECKBOX siblings are broken.

fiveWhys: 1. Why does child stay checked+enabled when parent unchecks? → FE Angular form has no disable() call on the modifier-checkbox control bound to parent state.
2. Why is it missing for these 3 groups specifically? → 8 working groups likely use a shared form-helper or directive; the 3 broken groups have hand-rolled wiring that omits the modifier checkbox.

3. Why does the server accept the malformed state? → No server-side validation rule rejecting {parent: false, child: true} on this endpoint. The location settings update accepts the entire object as the FE sends it.
4. Why was this systemic miss not caught? → No regression test in the framework covers the parent → modifier-checkbox-sibling cascade (only parent → percentage-INPUT cascade is asserted).

5. Why does it matter for production? → User-visible data integrity defect: customers see toggles whose state is inconsistent with parent feature, and the DB stores it that way. Any downstream code that reads child=true while parent=false will misbehave.
rcaSummary.rootCause: Two-layer defect: (a) FE — missing form-control disable/cascade wiring on 3 groups' modifier-checkbox children. (b) BE — missing server-side validation on location settings update endpoint that should reject inconsistent parent/child checkbox combinations.
rcaSummary.fixScope: Frontend: add cascade wiring + disable propagation on the 3 modifier-checkbox siblings (likely shareable via a single directive/helper). Backend: add validation on update-properties endpoint rejecting {parent: false, child: true} combinations. Both fixes required to fully close the bug.
